signal: Problem Radar scans could be reported as findings/content opportunities without proving downstream Powerhouse execution ownership.
root_cause: The skill described the closed loop but did not explicitly classify report-only completion as incomplete work.
invariant: Every accepted material radar signal remains owned through canonical PH-Pxxx/candidate projection and the next valid Powerhouse action: content, product gap or opportunity, followed by publication/readback where applicable and outcome learning.
evidence_boundaries: External evidence remains context/benchmark until tenant evidence supports relevance.
No capability claim without production evidence.
No LIVE/published claim without provider readback.
